feladatok.cim: Email to Dimitri accepting a musical invitation
feladatok.helyzet: You are doing a three-month language course in South London. You have received the following advertisement attached to an email from one of your fellow-students, Dimitri. He is going to see the famous musical The Phantom of the Opera on Saturday night and wants you to go with him.

bekezdesek: Musical by Andrew Lloyd Webber with lyrics by Charles Hart. Based on the novel Le Fantome de I'Opera by Gaston Leroux. Directed by Harold Prince.
Life under the Paris opera house.....
Winner! 'Best Musical' 1987 Olivier Awards Winner! 'Best Musical' 1986 Evening Standard Awards Winner! 'Audience Award for Most Popular Show' 2002

feladatok.teendo: Write an email of about 60 words to Dimitri in which you include the following:
iranyito_szempontok: Say why you are interested in the play.
Make a suggestion about when and where to meet on Saturday.

feladatok.cim: Letter to Desperate Teen about a shoplifting sister
feladatok.helyzet: You are a regular reader of the Internet forum "Teen Advice Online". You have found the following problem there and decided to give your opinion:

bekezdesek: I have a little sister who is only 12 years old and she shoplifts A LOT! Every time she comes home from the mall she has like hundreds of dollars' worth of jewelry and stuff.

I am starting to hope that she will get caught or she won’t stop. Is there a way I can get her to stop without getting her into a lot of trouble? Or should I just tell my dad? Or blackmail her to stop? I NEED HELP! Please email me back soon. Thanks for reading my letter.

feladatok.teendo: Write a letter of about 110 words to Desperate Teen, in which you give him/her advice about what s/he should do. Include the following points: S/he should
iranyito_szempontok: talk to his/her sister about: her reasons; the possible consequences;
ask his/her parents for advice; for help.
